jobs.title: People Operations Lead
jobs.description:
Reducto is the agentic document platform for leading AI teams who demand enterprise performance at scale. We provide a comprehensive toolkit for working with documents the way a human would, combining custom in-house and leading frontier models to power efficient and accurate document workflows.

We’ve grown rapidly, increasing revenue 8x year over year and partnering with hundreds of companies, from leading AI teams like Harvey, Vanta, and Scale, to enterprise customers across FAANG and top trading firms.

Reducto has raised over $100M from world-class investors including a16z, Benchmark, and First Round Capital.




THE OPPORTUNITY

We’re looking for our first People Operations Lead to help build the HR function from the ground up. You’ll partner directly with our founders and leadership to shape the employee experience end to end, from the moment someone joins through every milestone of their time here. This is a hands-on, high-touch role where you’ll own from onboarding to how we develop and retain world class talent.




WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Be the trusted person employees come to. Build genuine relationships across the company and keep a real pulse on what people are happy about, what they’re not, and what we can do better, then act on it.

 - Own employee relations: Guide people and managers through the moments that matter (leaves, life events, hard conversations, exits,...) with discretion and judgment that protect both our people and the company

 - Run the employee lifecycle end to end. Own a seamless onboarding and offboarding experience and every change in between (including coordinating things like immigration processes with outside counsel).

 - Support our managers. Coordinate enablement for our many first-time managers and partner with them on feedback, development, and retention so employees feel they’re progressing and fairly assessed at Reducto.

 - Make it easy to know how we work. Maintain clear, accessible documentation and policies so people can easily find what they need, and enforce and disseminate those policies consistently and fairly.

 - Support our performance process. Help operationalize performance cycles and, over time, support calibration across managers (Partner closely on the design).

 - Help keep the trains running. Manage payroll inputs and benefits administration and partner with vendors and look for ways to streamline workflows with modern tooling and AI.
   
   


YOU’LL THRIVE HERE IF YOU :

 - Have employee relations experience. You’ve handled sensitive, high-stakes people situations correctly before.

 - Have High EQ and warmth. People naturally feel comfortable coming to you; you build trust quickly and at every level.

 - Have Operational rigor. You can take a program: onboarding, immigration, a leave process, and run it cleanly from beginning to end without dropping details. You like building from scratch.

 - Handle confidential information thoughtfully and know what to share, with whom, and when.

 - Comfortable enforcing and disseminating policy. You can operate, communicate, and uphold policies and programs

 - Have 5+ years of People Operations / HR experience, ideally including some exposure to first-time-manager support and programs for managers.
   
   


BONUS POINTS IF YOU

 - Experience designing performance cycles and facilitating calibration meetings.

 - Compensation and leveling knowledge.

 - HR systems / HRIS implementation experience.

 - Familiarity with immigration processes (H-1B, green cards, TN visas)

 - Learning & development instincts.

 - Experience scaling a startup through rapid growth, and comfort using AI tools to streamline HR workflows.
   

Why Reducto

 - Impact: Your work directly shapes how the world’s best AI companies access and use enterprise data.

 - Speed: We move fast, ship often, and iterate in days, not months.

 - Learning: Work alongside world-class engineers, operators, and founders who care deeply about product, precision, and velocity.
   

Benefits

 - Unlimited PTO, because great work requires recharging.

 - Daily Lunch, enjoy free lunch with teammates in the office.

 - Commuter Reimbursement, we’ll cover your transportation costs.

 - Comprehensive Insurance, medical, dental, and vision.

 - Health and Wellness Budget, up to $150 per month for wellness spending such as gym memberships or fitness classes.

 - Parental Leave, flexible scheduling that works for you and your family.

 - 401k + 4% company match


This is an in-person role based in our San Francisco office. We’re an early-stage company, we move fast and work hard. Please apply only if that excites you.

Compensation for this role is $150,000-$200,000 + equity

 

Equal Opportunity
Reducto is an Equal Opportunity Employer committed to diversity and inclusion in the workplace. All qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to sex, race, color, age, national origin, religion, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, or any other protected category.

jobs.description:
ABOUT US

Reducto is the agentic document platform for leading AI teams who demand enterprise performance at scale. We provide a comprehensive toolkit for working with documents the way a human would, combining custom in-house and leading frontier models to power efficient and accurate document workflows.

We’ve grown rapidly, increasing revenue 8x year over year and partnering with hundreds of companies, from leading AI teams like Harvey, Vanta, and Scale, to enterprise customers across FAANG and top trading firms.

Reducto has raised over $100M from world-class investors including a16z, Benchmark, and First Round Capital.




THE OPPORTUNITY

As part of the early Customer Success team, you'll help to build our customer success function from the ground up while managing a portfolio of high-value customers to drive logo retention and NRR. You'll work directly with technical teams using Reducto to solve complex document processing challenges, ensuring they get maximum value from our platform. This is a unique opportunity to shape how we deliver customer success at a rapidly growing AI infrastructure company.


WE WOULD LOVE TO MEET YOU IF THE FOLLOWING RESONATES:

 - You're Strategic and Technical: You can dive deep with technical teams to understand their document processing challenges while maintaining a strategic view of their business objectives. You're comfortable discussing both technical implementation details and big-picture business outcomes.

 - You're Process-Oriented: You know how to build scalable success processes and can establish the foundations for a world-class CS organization.

 - You're Data-Driven: You're skilled at tracking and analyzing customer health metrics, usage data, and business outcomes. You use data to drive your decisions and to demonstrate clear ROI to customers.

 - You're an Exceptional Communicator: You can effectively engage with both technical practitioners and executive stakeholders. You excel at written documentation, customer training, and leading strategic business reviews.

 - You're Proactive and Independent: You don't wait for problems to surface – you actively monitor customer health and spot opportunities to drive additional value. You're comfortable working autonomously while building processes for scale.




THE CORE WORK WILL INCLUDE:


70% OF TIME

 - Managing a portfolio of enterprise customers from implementation through expansion

 - Conducting regular business reviews and maintaining strong relationships with key stakeholders

 - Monitoring customer health metrics and proactively addressing potential issues

 - Creating and executing customer success playbooks for different customer segments


30% OF TIME

 - Building our customer success function from the ground up

 - Establishing processes for onboarding, training, and ongoing customer engagement

 - Creating scalable customer enablement content and documentation

 - Partnering with Product and Engineering to represent the voice of the customer


YOU ARE LIKELY A STRONG FIT IF:

 - You’ve worked with Enterprise clients in consulting for 4+ years

 - You’re familiar with ML/AI infrastructure or developer tools

 - You have a technical background or strong interest in AI/ML


BONUS POINTS IF YOU:

 - Have previously worked at a high-growth startup

 - Bring established relationships in the ML/AI ecosystem

 - Have demonstrable experience growing accounts and driving expansions

At Reducto, we’re invested in the well-being and growth of our team. Here’s what we currently offer:

 - Unlimited PTO: We believe great work requires recharging.

 - Lunch: Receive a free lunch to eat with your teammates daily at the office

 - Reimbursed Transportation: Provide us with your receipts and we’ll take care of the costs

 - Comfort with Ambiguity: You've operated in early-stage or high-ambiguity environments where playbooks don't exist yet, and you're energized rather than paralyzed by that kind of blank page.

 - Commercial Instincts: You think like a seller. Whether you've carried a quota, run partner management, or worked in a revenue-tied BD role, you know how to turn a relationship into pipeline and pipeline into revenue.

 - Cross-Functional Fluency: You can align product, engineering, legal, and GTM stakeholders around a shared partner vision, and you have the executive presence to represent Reducto in rooms with senior partner counterparts.

 - GTM Storytelling: You can shape a clear, compelling narrative about why a partnership matters — for partners, for customers, and for the internal teams who need to rally around it.


THE CORE WORK WILL INCLUDE:

 - Defining and executing Reducto's strategic partnerships roadmap across cloud hyperscalers and frontier model labs, from initial outreach through signed agreement

 - Identifying, prioritizing, and initiating relationships with the partners best positioned to accelerate Reducto's distribution, credibility, and product reach

 - Structuring and negotiating partnership agreements, including co-sell, marketplace, and product-integration motions

 - Building the internal muscle — processes, talking points, and relationships with product and engineering — needed to execute co-sell and co-build motions once partnerships are live

 - Defining and tracking success metrics for each partnership (partner-sourced pipeline, revenue, product adoption) and reporting progress to leadership

 - Acting as Reducto's primary point of contact for key partners, including executive-level communications and business reviews

 - Staying close to the fast-moving cloud and frontier model landscape to spot new partnership opportunities before they become obvious


BONUS POINTS IF YOU:

 - Existing relationships with partnership teams at major hyperscalers or frontier model labs

 - Experience in document processing, AI infrastructure, or developer-facing technical products

 - A background as a quota-carrying seller or partner manager in enterprise software

 - Experience building a partnerships function from scratch at an early-stage startup

Reducto has raised over $100M from world-class investors including a16z, Benchmark, and First Round Capital.



THE OPPORTUNITY

As a Senior Content Marketing Manager at Reducto, you'll build the content engine that earns trust with our core audiences — from the AI and software teams building and optimizing document processes to the business leaders and knowledge workers working with documents day-to-day. You’ll create long- and short-form content across blogs, guides, cookbooks, videos, customer stories, decision-enablement materials and social channels.

This is a hands-on writing role on our Brand and Content team. You'll publish long-form content across the technical and non-technical spectrum, interview customers and turn their results into stories Sales can use, run our social and newsletter presence, and build the content engine to give every asset a second and third life. You’ll work closely with our Growth team to fuel our SEO/GEO efforts, so we show up both in search results and in the AI answers our buyers increasingly rely on.

You'll report to our Brand and Content Lead and partner closely across DevRel, Product Marketing, Growth, Product, Engineering, and Sales.

This is an on-site role based in our San Francisco office. 

What You'll Do

 - Drive Reducto's editorial POV — the themes we own, the arguments we make, and the beats we return to — and translate it into a quarterly content plan tied to company priorities.

 - Own Reducto's editorial calendar and publish content across the full range of our audience — engineering deep dives, benchmark write-ups, and technical guides alongside workflow breakdowns, business-process content, and industry pieces for the teams that live in these documents every day.

 - Create the content that powers our SEO and GEO programs, working from the topics, keywords, and questions our Growth and Product Marketing partners prioritize — and shaping pieces so they're citable, structured, and quotable by both search engines and AI assistants.

 - Interview customers and turn their results into case studies, stories, and proof points that Sales, Growth, and Product Marketing can put to work.

 - Own social and newsletter distribution across LinkedIn, X, and developer communities, adapting each piece to how that audience actually reads.

 - Turn every major asset into a distribution program — repurposing launches, benchmarks, and customer wins into posts, threads, newsletters, and sales collateral.

 - Partner with DevRel, Engineering and Product to translate technical depth into content that's accurate and credible to a technical reader — and with Sales and customers to ground business content in how document workflows actually break.

 - Develop content briefs, manage freelancers and contributors, and hold a consistent bar for voice, accuracy, and quality.

 - Work with Brand to keep our content unmistakably Reducto in voice and design, and with Growth and Marketing Operations to connect content to traffic, signups, activation, and pipeline.

 - Track the topics, questions, and objections showing up in Sales calls, docs, and communities, then build content that answers them.

 - Maintain and evolve Reducto's content standards, style guide, and messaging consistency as the team grows.

 - Have 4–7 years of experience in content marketing, editorial, or a related role, ideally at a B2B software company.

 - Understand how to make content perform across multiple channels and can build systems to measure your impact.

 - Are a strong writer who can go from a rough concept to a published piece without heavy editing.

 - Have an editorial point of view — you can decide what's worth saying and why it matters, not just execute a calendar someone else built.

 - Can write credibly for a wide range of technical audiences — from an engineer evaluating an API and an operations leader rethinking a document-heavy process — and know when to switch registers.

 - Have created content that fed an SEO program, and understand how search and AI-generated answers surface and cite content.

 - Have interviewed customers and shipped case studies that Sales genuinely uses.

 - Have run social and newsletter distribution, and treat distribution as part of the job rather than an afterthought.

 - Can hold your own with engineers — asking good questions, reading the docs, and getting the details right.

This is a pivotal hire that will shape how we sell to the world’s most complex organizations and unlock our next phase of growth.

In this role you will lead and develop a team of Growth Account Executives, and define the sales motion, playbook, and culture that powers Reducto’s upmarket expansion. You will work directly with the founding team, influence product direction, and help build the GTM foundation from the ground up.

 


WE WOULD LOVE TO MEET YOU IF YOU POSSESS THE FOLLOWING:

 - Leadership: You have a proven track record of building, coaching, and scaling high-performing growth/mid-market sales teams. You develop talent methodically — through joint selling, call reviews, pipeline coaching, and structured career paths — and have a history of promoting reps into senior roles.

 - Growth/Mid-Market Sales Experience: You have 6–10+ years of growth/mid-market B2B SaaS experience, including at least 2–4 years in a management or player/coach capacity. You have personally closed or managed deals with $100K+ ACV, navigated multi-threaded stakeholder environments, and run long, complex sales cycles from discovery through procurement.

 - Builder Mentality: You are energized by ambiguity. You don’t need a playbook handed to you — you build the playbook. You’ve stood up sales motions from near-zero at a high-growth startup and know how to create structure without bureaucracy.

 - Technical Acumen: You can hold your own in a conversation with a VP of Engineering, Head of AI, or enterprise architect. You understand API-based products, the AI/ML infrastructure landscape, and how technical teams evaluate and procure developer tooling. You can translate complex capabilities into business value for both technical and executive buyers.

 - Forecasting & Pipeline Rigor: You run tight forecasting processes. You use data to diagnose risk, coach reps, and communicate clearly to leadership. You are comfortable with MEDDPICC or equivalent qualification frameworks and enforce them consistently.

 - Cross-Functional Partnership: You partner fluidly with Product, Marketing, RevOps, and Customer Success. You translate field insights into product feedback, align on ICP with marketing, and ensure seamless handoffs post-close. You are a builder of systems, not just relationships.


THE CORE WORK WILL INCLUDE:

 - Lead, coach, and develop a team of Growth Account Executives focused on complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles with $100K–$1M+ ACV targets

 - Define and implement Reducto’s growth sales motion — including qualification methodology, discovery frameworks, mutual action plans, and executive engagement strategies

 - Build and refine the growth sales playbook, including competitive positioning, objection handling, and champion development strategies

 - Establish forecasting practices, pipeline review cadences, and CRM hygiene standards for the growth segment

 - Partner with RevOps to design territory models, account segmentation, quota structures, and performance reporting

 - Collaborate with Marketing on growth demand generation, ABM programs, and field event strategy

 - Partner with Product to surface growth requirements, influence the roadmap, and ensure our solution addresses the most critical customer pain points

 - Hire, onboard, and ramp a world-class team of Growth AEs as we scale
